subject: Life Skills
title: Inflation and Your Purchasing Power
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Inflation and Your Purchasing Power.

hook.text: In 1990, a movie ticket cost $4. Today the same ticket costs $12. Your salary tripled, but so did everything else.

buildup.text: Inflation means prices rise over time. Money sitting in a 0.5% checking account loses purchasing power every year.

discovery.text: At 3% annual inflation, your money's purchasing power halves in about 24 years.

twist.text: A 3% raise in a 3% inflation year is not a raise. It is treading water.

climax.text: Invest your long-term savings in assets that historically outpace inflation: diversified index funds average 7–10% over.

punchline.text: Cash saved loses value. Cash invested fights back.

quiz.question: Why does cash in a low-interest account lose value over time?
options: Banks charge hidden fees that drain the balance
Inflation erodes purchasing power faster than low interest offsets it
Cash accounts have an expiration date
